messages:
deploy-bot: promotion failed for release 'auth/2025-06-01' in prod-eu-west-1. helm upgrade aborted: failed to render values - missing KMS key reference `secrets.kms.keyId`. Chart v3.0.1 expects `secrets.kms.keyId` present. other regions ok.

rachel: confirmed in logs: template error during helm upgrade because values overlay didn't include kms.keyId. staging had a default path but prod overlay relies on env var that didn't populate.

devops: how urgent? can we pin to chart v3.0.0 to avoid template validation?

nate: v3.0.0 lacks newer secret mounting behavior; app binary coming in 3.0.1 expects KMS-backed secret fetch. If we pin chart we'll also need to roll back code. Not great.

release-manager: options: 1) revert image to pre-3.0.1 (fast); 2) hotpatch prod overlay to inject `secrets.kms.keyId` (hotfix); 3) propagate env var from vault agent (infra) and retry. Need quick decision.

infra-bot: vault sync for prod-eu-west-1 currently shows missing key alias `payments-kms`. Recent key rotation last night renamed alias. Propagation ETA ~25m.

rachel: hotpatch overlay seems quickest and least risky. We'll add a values shim: `secrets:
  kms:
    keyId: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/OLD-ALIAS` and mark as temporary.

devops: create PR + include cleanup ticket. Also update release notes with exact helm command and rollback snippet.

nate: add rollback plan: if hotpatch fails, run `helm rollback auth-release <previous_revision> --namespace prod` and scale down canary. Also note to revert image if we accidentally rolled image.

release-manager: checklist in thread:
1) open hotpatch PR against prod-overlays (rachel)
2) apply to canary namespace and run `helm template` to validate (devops)
3) re-run deploy-bot promotion for prod-eu-west-1 (deploy-bot)
4) monitor canary SLOs for 10m, rollback if errors > 0.5%
5) file cleanup ticket to remove shim after vault key alias fix (release-manager)

rachel: PR: hotfix/prod-eu-kms-shim-1781239999 opened and applied to canary. Helm template passes.

deploy-bot: promotion queued after template check.

infra-bot: KMS alias propagation job in flight; still ETA 18m.

devops: applying canary now, will set fraction 3% and watch logs.

deploy-bot: canary up at 3%. initial health good.

release-manager: I'll update release notes: "temporary KMS key shim applied in prod-eu-west-1 due to key alias rotation; cleanup planned after vault sync." Include rollback commands.

nate: noted. creating ENG-2412 to remove shim and harden overlay preflight.

deploy-bot: promotion completed to prod-eu-west-1 after 12m observation. pinned-chart flag: false.

rachel: thanks team — follow-up: add helm preflight that validates required values keys are present in overlays before chart promotion.

devops: filing devx ticket now. thread closing once cleanup ticket assigned. :white_check_mark:
